segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so for Northline's calibration team, I have you at 28 technician seats to start, plus 6 manager seats, with the asset tracking and due-date alerts included. Does that match what you wanted for the March rollout?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Mostly. We have 28 techs live in March, but another 12 in the second plant won't need access until May 6. I don't want to pay for those early if they're not using it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fair. We can start with 34 seats on March 1, then add the 12 technician seats on May 6 and co-term them to the same February 28 end date. The May seats would be prorated for the remaining 10 months.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. What's the monthly equivalent on that? Finance keeps asking even though we'll pay annual.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For the first 34 seats, it's $3,060 per month equivalent, billed annually at $36,720. The 12 added seats in May are $840 per month equivalent, so the prorated add-on is $8,400 for the rest of the term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: And implementation is still the $4,800, right? That includes importing our gauge list?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. One-time $4,800. That includes the import for up to 9,000 assets, your user setup, and two admin training sessions. You said your current file is about 7,600 rows, so you're inside that.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One thing on invoices: can you split software and implementation into separate line items? Same invoice is fine, just separate lines for our coding.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, separate line items on the invoice. Annual subscription, prorated May add-on noted as a future order, and implementation as its own line.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Contract term is March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Payment terms net 30, auto-renewal off unless you choose to renew, and the go-live target is March 18 assuming we get the asset file by February 20.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Send it over at those numbers and I'll route it with the PO request this afternoon.
